messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@findata.ai>

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for moving this along. We reviewed the redlines your legal team proposed (attached Redlines_FinData_v2.pdf) and have a few execution questions so we can get the envelope out to our execs today:

- Which e-sign vendor does Redwood require for countersignature? Our procurement prefers AdobeSign but we can use DocuSign if needed.
- Please confirm the signatory authority matrix for Redwood (who signs on behalf of Redwood vs who will countersign). We need exact titles for our internal routing.
- On subprocessors: your redline in section 4.2 references an updated subprocessor list. Will you provide a current CSV export and confirm whether the list triggers any new export controls/data-transfer clauses for EU data?
- Audit logs: what retention and delivery frequency can we expect on envelope status and audit trail (pdf + audit log)?

Can you confirm before 10am PT if possible — Samir is standing by to start routing.

Thanks,

Laura Chen
Legal Operations | FinData Analytics
laura.chen@findata.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@findata.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA execution logistics - signatory questions

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline below and a suggested execution checklist.

1) E-sign vendor: DocuSign is our default and integrates with our audit pipelines; we can accept AdobeSign for this deal but we will need an envelope-export (PDF + audit log) delivered to our S3 bucket and a webhook to notify completion. If you send Adobe manually, please confirm the webhook config and that the provider will include the full audit trail.

2) Signatory authority (for your routing):
  - Redwood signer: Dylan Brooks, VP, Legal Ops (reps authority to sign DPA and standard SaaS agreements)
  - Countersign: CFO or Head of Revenue for amounts/commits above agreed threshold; for this deal Samir confirmed countersign by CFO is not required.
  - If legal needs delegated signers, we accept signatory delegation but require an email from the delegator and a title match in the envelope.

3) Subprocessors: we maintain a current subprocessor list and export it as CSV. Attaching a lightweight signing_matrix.csv that lists the subprocessor CSV and the doc link; full subprocessor export will be shared via the Drive folder. Per our DPA, transfers to EU are covered by standard SCCs embedded in the DPA; if you have local regulator-specific clauses, flag them and we can escalate.

4) Audit logs / retention: we can provide envelope PDF + DocuSign audit log delivered to S3 within 24 hours of final signature. Retention can be configured for 7 years per customer preference (we typically retain 3 years by default for hosted customers).

Suggested quick checklist to start routing:
  - You: choose DocuSign or Adobe and confirm webhook target (we can provide URL + HMAC).
  - You: confirm Redwood signer name and email for envelope.
  - Us: pre-populate envelope with signature blocks and required fields; include a placeholder for the subprocessor appendix initial.
  - Us: enable automatic status webhooks + immediate S3 export on completion.

DocuSign link (test envelope stub): https://na2.docusign.net/envelope/1234abcd
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1149

I'll attach the signing matrix and loop in Karthik to approve webhook/S3 settings.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: signing_matrix.csv

Also: can Redwood provide a signed-by field in the PDF that includes title + company? Some of our systems require exact title parity.

Thanks — starting routing now.

Samir Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager | FinData Analytics
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@findata.ai>, Laura Chen <laura@findata.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA execution logistics - signatory questions

Thanks Samir — we can accept AdobeSign. Final execution notes and monitoring plan below (please treat as checklist for routing team):

- Envelope vendor: AdobeSign (OK) — FinData to send and include the following: Audit log PDF, combined document PDF, and an envelope-level audit.json (or equivalent) as attachments. Filename pattern: findata_rdwdpa_<deal>_<env-id>_audit.json (we'll ingest this into our S3).
- Signed-by field: include signer full name + title + company on the signature block (e.g., "Dylan Brooks, VP Legal Operations, Redwood Inference").
- Countersign: Redwood will sign first (Dylan Brooks). If FinData requires countersignature after Redwood, please route to marissa@redwood.inference.com for countersign (Marissa will countersign only if CFO sign-off not required).
- Delegation: if Samir or Laura delegate the sign to another FinData exec, we require an explicit delegation email from the delegator before acceptance.
- Audit delivery: please configure Adobe webhook to POST to our ingestion endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.inference.com/esign-callback?hmac=REDACTED. We will acknowledge and begin S3 export; we expect final PDF + audit within 24h.
- Status checks: Karthik will monitor envelope progress. Internal Slack channel #esign-status will receive automatic updates. If envelope stalls >48h, tag legal-ops for manual escalation.

Next steps (today):
  1) FinData: send Adobe envelope with fields + audit attachments using filename pattern above.
  2) FinData: reply-all with envelope id and estimated signing timeline.
  3) Redwood: Karthik to confirm webhook receipt and set ingestion TTL.

If that all looks good I will mark the HubSpot deal as "Contract sent" and update the close plan.

Best,

Dylan
VP, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
